display.title: Episode 542: Reb Asher the Melamed, Chapter 2 (Shabbos Mevarchim Elul)
display.summary_short: Shabbos Mevarchim Elul and the wonders of the moon; Reb Asher refuses to bow to an idol and faces a firing squad, then discovers he knows the minister.
display.summary_long: Broadcast before Shabbos Mevarchim Elul 5752. Uncle Yossi explains that Elul, the last month of the year, is the time to end well by davening, learning and giving more. He tells children to listen in shul when the chazan announces the molad, the exact moment of the new moon, and describes how the moon grows and shrinks each month: the heavens tell of Hashem's glory, and He guides every star and planet. After the march and a recap, a boy who is signing up friends for letters in a new Sefer Torah leads the Shema. Story time continues 'Reb Asher the Melamed': in chains, Reb Asher is brought before a tall statue and told to bow or die. He covers his eyes, says Shema Yisrael and refuses, ready to give his life for Hashem. Shots ring out, yet he is still standing: the minister had ordered blank shots. Weeping, the minister asks, 'Don't you recognize me?', and Reb Asher suddenly remembers. The answer waits for next week. Children then give tzedakah and say Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery, and the Summer Spectacular is promoted again.
display.lesson: Elul is the time to finish the year well; and a Jew stays loyal to Hashem even at the risk of his life.

date.note: 'Right before Shabbos Mevarchim Rosh Chodesh Elul' (Shabbos 22 August 1992) and still promoting the 23 August event; the candle-lighting time given (7:16) fits 28 August rather than 21 August.
